visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Multiple people wearing red sweaters or hoodies stand around small black stools arranged in a circle. On each stool sits a red envelope. A woman in a dark red sweater holds a microphone, directing the participants. They perform physical micro-actions like touching their heads and eyes before lunging to grab the envelopes on command. The room is dimly lit with warm, ambient spotlights. (2) The scene cuts to a rhythmic game where a man in a plaid vest and a woman stand before a large TV screen displaying karaoke lyrics. They use exaggerated hand gestures and facial expressions, shouting in rhythm. The background features a large TV screen and a decorative fireplace. Other friends watch from the side, clapping and laughing in a high-energy, celebratory environment. (3) The group transitions to a seated word-connection game. They sit on stools in a line, clapping their hands rhythmically on their knees to maintain the beat. A mahjong table covered with a green cloth sits in the foreground. Characters exhibit focused facial expressions and burst into laughter when someone fails a prompt. The lighting remains bright and consistent within the indoor studio-like setting. (4) A small child wearing a red Mickey Mouse sweater is featured sitting among the adults, participating in the rhythm game. The camera pans across the line of people, capturing their dynamic reactions. Text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear frequently at the bottom, highlighting the game rules and funny responses. The environment is filled with social gathering elements like drinks and snacks on side tables. (5) The final phase shows the group in collective hysteria, laughing and pointing at each other. Some characters stand up and wave their hands in the air. The editing uses rapid cuts to capture various angles of the group's excitement. The background details include soundproofing panels and modern interior decor typical of a private party venue.
